title: Cast Asleep by an Enchantress (F4M)
description: You notice your breathing more than anything else. It's not the crashing of your feet against the packed dirt, slightly damp from the day's long downpour that has been going since yesterday. It's not the wind brushing up against your hood as you move your head in and against it, threatening to pull back, to leave you open, vulnerable. It's not the dark night, pierced by a glowing full moon as you walk underneath the trees. Headed home. But so much farther to go. No — it's your breathing. You notice it's shallow. Coming fast. A chill tendril of air, tickling against the back of your neck, sending a shiver through you as the hairs tingle upwards. Frizzled along by a sense, a feeling of the unknown.
author: Mistress Shibby
